checklist.rule: Launch all required existing lanes once per x1 boundary, then hand supervision to watcher and notifier helpers.
Do not manually poll sibling status before the configured x1 or x2 gate unless a helper emits a blocker receipt.
Use Aletheon wait windows for research, reflection, build planning, command-surface review, and next-phase preparation.
Treat duration as planning support only; phase advance still requires all required lane receipts.
If a watcher wrapper fails to publish completion, use probe, direct notify, redaction, direct repair gate, and five-lane normalizer before declaring a blocker.

enforcement_note: The watcher-first rule is operationally mandatory for future wait windows unless a safety guard requires immediate pause.
